deals.headline: Sarver-led group takes 81.16% of RCD Mallorca via a EUR 20.6m capital increase
deals.investor: Liga ACQ Legacy Partners LLC (Robert Sarver, Andy Kohlberg, Steve Nash)
deals.summary: Phoenix Suns owner Robert Sarver's consortium (with Andy Kohlberg and Steve Nash), investing through Liga ACQ Legacy Partners LLC, covered the whole of Mallorca's capital increase with EUR 20.6m (El Pais: EUR 20,620,012) and took 81.16%; previous owner Utz Claassen kept about 19%. The money went to the club, not to a seller.

deals.evidence: se ha completado con los 28 millones de CVC, un Plan Impulso que el club ya ha iniciado su devolución
deals.headline: Mallorca draws €28m from LaLiga Impulso (CVC)
deals.summary: Mallorca joined LaLiga Impulso, under which CVC funds reach clubs as a 50-year participating loan from LaLiga. Ultima Hora puts the club's CVC money at €28m, part of it used for the Son Moix and training-ground works. The club's 2024/25 accounts (scanned PDF) give the adhesion date as 2 December 2021 and total drawdowns of €28,308,018.68 over 2021/22-2023/24, repayable to 30 June 2072.

deals.date_text: Announced 26 November 2022; approved at the AGM of 27 December 2022

deals.headline: €14.7m capital increase funds the Son Moix and training-ground works
deals.investor: Existing shareholders led by Andy Kohlberg and Robert Sarver
deals.summary: Mallorca issued 1,570,000 new shares at €3 nominal plus a €6.37 premium, a €14,710,900 capital increase used entirely for the Son Moix renovation (finished January 2024) and the Antonio Asensio training ground, alongside the CVC loan.

deals.investor: Shareholder group led by Andy Kohlberg
deals.summary: The group of shareholders led by club president Andy Kohlberg agreed to acquire the shares of Robert Sarver and additional investors, with effect from 30 June, making Kohlberg the majority shareholder. No price or stake was disclosed.

name: Real Club Deportivo Mallorca, S.A.D.
notes: Relegated at the end of 2025-26: the club plays 2026-27 in LaLiga Hypermotion (Segunda División), as its own fixtures pages and LaLiga show; the league field is left as given. The 2024/25 audited accounts (the latest; FY to 30 June 2025) are a scanned PDF with no text layer, so the revenue figure is taken from Diario de Mallorca's report of them (EUR 72.6m) while the accounts themselves state importe neto de la cifra de negocios EUR 72,570,093.25 (2023/24: EUR 71,201,163.45), net loss EUR 9,999,323.87, net equity EUR 30.7m, and list Liga ACQ Legacy Partners as the only shareholder at or above 10% (99.99%); facts sourced to that PDF carry the figure as printed and may fail an automated text check. Revenue lines in the accounts: competitions EUR 4.93m, season tickets/members EUR 7.66m, facilities EUR 3.04m, broadcasting EUR 44.35m, merchandising EUR 0.04m, advertising EUR 12.55m (no matchday or commercial total is printed, so those breakdown fields are null). Who owns Liga ACQ Legacy Partners and the individual stakes of Kohlberg, Nash, Kerr and Holden are not published. Son Moix: Diario de Mallorca's June 2026 article gives 26,020 seats in its headline and list but 25,736 in one sentence. No Forbes or other valuation found. Social total is the club's own March 2025 milestone (all networks incl. Weibo, Threads, WhatsApp, Twitch; Blinkfire cited). Honours (no league title): Copa del Rey 2003, Supercopa de España 1998, per the club history. Kohlberg denied in January 2026 that a new shareholder was joining.

ownership_summary: RCD Mallorca SAD's 2024/25 audited accounts list a single shareholder at or above 10%: Liga ACQ Legacy Partners with 99.99%. Liga ACQ Legacy Partners LLC is the vehicle through which Robert Sarver, Andy Kohlberg and Steve Nash bought 81.16% in January 2016 by funding a EUR 20.6m capital increase (Palco23, El Pais). Since Kohlberg's group bought out Sarver in June 2023, president Andy Kohlberg has been the majority shareholder; Steve Nash, Steve Kerr (since August 2023) and Stuart Holden are minority investors. No private-equity, sovereign or other institutional holder is disclosed.
